description: Step 3 Repair Loop configuration. Repair is local (failed stage only), budget-bound, and feedback-driven.

RERUN_FROM_UPSTREAM.description: Discard the stale output and re-run the stage: it re-derives its output from the CURRENT upstream artifacts. Used when references went stale (e.g. a gap_id changed upstream).

DROP_INVALID_PRODUCTS.description: Remove candidates whose product_id is absent from the Product Catalog from the stage input, then re-run. Never invents a replacement product.

ESCALATE.description: No automatic repair exists (schema violation, contamination, provenance gap). Escalate to NEEDS_REVIEW.
